scripts.test: node src/lib/metadata.test.mjs && node src/lib/regional.test.mjs && node src/lib/lyrics.test.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx --yes netlify-cli deploy --prod --dir=dist --functions=netlify/functions
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && npx --yes netlify-cli deploy --dir=dist --functions=netlify/functions
scripts.docker:rebuild: docker rm -f sur-music 2>/dev/null; docker build -t sur-music-app . && docker run -d --name sur-music -p 5173:5173 sur-music-app && echo 'http://localhost:5173'
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
